card.name: Words just before primary or secondary
card.fires_on: Small linking words, such as to, for, and, a, or before, in news or health text where the next word could plausibly be 'primary' or 'secondary', often in talk of schools, children, or disease stages. It also fires on odd spots like the middle of a place name or URL.

modes.label: Before school level
modes.description: Linking word after 'go' or 'improve' where primary or secondary school or education could follow.
modes.example: Only after that do I go<< to>> school," said Gyorgy Radav

modes.label: Clause links in medical or news text
modes.description: A verb or 'and' in a sentence where a primary or secondary item (cancer, moiety) may come next.
modes.example: 43% of patients with ulcerative colitis will<< develop>> colon cancer within 25 to

modes.label: Odd mid-name spots
modes.description: Partway through a place name or web address with no clear link to the promoted words.
modes.example: PEDAL cars raced around Netherav<<on>> on Monday in the village's second pedal
